value: Study participants: 15 semi-isolated Yanomami individuals from Brazil
Comparative groups: Yanomami from Venezuela (n=8), Matses (n=24), Tunapuco (n=12), US urban individuals (n=44)
Sample type: Fecal samples (single stool sample per subject)
Sequencing depth: approximately 14 million reads per sample on average
Total reads generated: approximately 219 million reads
Non-host reads after filtering: approximately 198 million reads
Ethics approval: Oswaldo Cruz Foundation Ethics Research Committee No. 638/11 and CONEP No. 16907
Study focus: Taxonomic and functional characterization of gut microbiome in Amazonian hunter-gatherer groups
